sourceLanguage.description: The language the toon is written in; every other language is a translation of it. Default: `languages[0]`, else the first `i18n` key, else `de`.

languages.description: Every language of the toon, the source first. Default: the `i18n` keys (source first).

ToonIndex.description: One toon's entry in `toons.json` (language-neutral). The creator keeps the newest version of it in the content store as `<toon>/_/index.json` (see `TOON_INDEX_FILE`); read the languages with `toonLanguages()`.
